$comment: WRK-008 slice 2b Step 9a — each D1 worker's declared DISPATCH gate posture, checked
The plan's 'D1 must enable dispatch in its own compose file as a separate, attributable
change' made mechanical. ALL FOUR landable gates are declared, not just the flag: a
checker that parsed only AOA_WORKER_DISPATCH_ENABLED would stay green through the event
expect: 'absent' = the var must NOT be set; 'present' = set (any value); else the exact value.

Blocker B: the worker image now CONTAINS worker-networked-host, so AOA_WORKER_PROVIDER_URL stopped being unreadable-by-any-code. The gate moved to the command/entrypoint, which this env-only checker cannot see - scripts/lib/d1-compose-invariants.mjs carries that clause.

dispatchEnabled.reason: dispatch is OFF; enabling it is a separate attributable compose diff.

keyStoreMode.reason: gate 3: mounted_secret with no OS-custody store means no device identity — the container's structural identity gate.

sandboxProvider.reason: gate 1: the DEP-010 resolver reads this; absent ⇒ no provider. D1 runs bin/worker-daemon.js (the CONTAINER root), which has no resolver at all, so gate 1 stays STRUCTURAL through Sprint 2.

e2bTemplate.reason: the second half of the DEP-010 provider construction; absent.

providerUrl.reason: PRESENT, and NO LONGER DEAD CODE. Set to a live in-net fake-provider for health. Until Blocker B no shipped image contained a bin that reads it, so it was inert whoever set it; the worker image now ships worker-networked-host at /worker-net-app/dist/bin/networked-host.js, which DOES read it. The image CMD still enters the DAEMON bin (repointing it globally would crash-loop the fleet: runContainerHost builds FileRecordStores unconditionally and resolveCustody REFUSES mounted_secret with stores), so the gate is now the command/entrypoint, NOT this variable. checkWorkersEnterTheDaemonBin in scripts/lib/d1-compose-invariants.mjs guards that override; this row records that the variable itself is deliberately present.

eventOutboxPath.reason: gate 4: absent ⇒ no durable outbox home ⇒ no_event_outbox_path (refuses first only once gates 1/3 pass).

dispatchEnabled.reason: dispatch is OFF; enabling it is a separate attributable compose diff.

keyStoreMode.reason: gate 3: mounted_secret with no OS-custody store means no device identity.

sandboxProvider.reason: gate 1: absent ⇒ no provider; D1 runs the container root with no resolver.

providerUrl.reason: PRESENT, and NO LONGER DEAD CODE — see worker-a. The gate is the command/entrypoint (guarded by checkWorkersEnterTheDaemonBin), not this variable.
